complexity.correctness_reason: On the permitted input lists = [[]] (Example 3: an empty chain, head None), the line `vals = [node.val for node in lists]` raises AttributeError because None has no `.val`.
complexity.notes: The `vals` list is dead code: it is built, updated, and shrunk but its contents are never consulted, so it can be removed entirely, saving the O(k) extra space. The short-circuit on equality only helps when consecutive emitted values tie, which is rare with a wide value range, so the scan is effectively O(k) per emitted node. A faster O(n log k) approach exists using ||a min-heap of the k chain heads|| or ||pairwise (divide-and-conquer) merging of the chains||.
complexity.summary: For each output node, the code linearly scans all k current chain heads to find the minimum, short-circuiting the scan when a head equals the value just emitted; it then appends that node and advances the chain, deleting exhausted chains from the list. A parallel `vals` list is maintained but never read.
